title: xDrip unable to import blood tests values with "MEALTYPE:5" ="Bedtime"
body:
I have a accu-check aviva connect. It allows the user to set one out of 6 mealtypes:
- Before meal
- After meal
- Fasting
- Bedtime
- Other
- No entry

Whenever the value "Bedtime" is selected, xDrip is unable to import the value and writes the following into the log:
BluetoothGlucoseMeter: Received context packet but we're not sure what its for: Context: Sequence: 2467 MEALTYPE: 5

I can confirm that all other "mealtypes" work.

comments.body:
Hi @Navid200 , I just tried it again and still not able to import.

Xdrip version: 344702e-2021.02.11
Meter is a AccuChek Guide. Same error message (different sequence number).

Workaround: I'm not using that flag anymore.

You import what to what?
This is a blood glucose meter, right?
So, I suppose you want to import a blood glucose meter reading?
You import the reading to what?  xDrip?  What for, calibration?  Is it Bluetooth?  If not, how is the data transferred?

I have an accu-chek guide set up as a bluetooth blood glucose meter. The meter automatically sends readings to xdrip. On the meter, I can select those "meal types" I listed above. All but the "bedtime" are imported fine into xdrip. If I select "bedtime", they do not get imported and do not show up. The error message I listed is visible in the log.

I have xdrip set up to automatically calibrate with readings received through bluetooth.

All apart from the above works fine.

Considering you have a work-around, I am postponing this by adding the appropriate label.  This will let us identify it in the closed issues.  
This lets us focus on more critical issues and get to this when there is bandwidth.
Thanks for reporting and updating and responding to questions.
Soon, I'll touch the glucometer sources because I've some trouble with the FORA 6 Connect. Then I can have a quick look.
